rv.q: Both the colourful adolescent world of cheerleaders and crushes and the camply cut-throat environment of the magazine industry are enjoyably amped up in Andy Fickman’s production, with fun and spirited choreography from Jennifer Weber.
13 Going On 30 knows it’s a frosted cupcake of a musical, and it leans all the way in.
Overall, the production is a triumph, ending with a huge standing ovation.
13 Going On 30 the Musical is a joyous, feel good musical.
With strong central performances and a nostalgic heart, it feels like a production that could grow into a sparkling addition to the stage musical canon.
